Name: Ethiopian Heirloom
Tasting_Notes: the bean
Desc:
The Organic Ethiopian heirloom coffee grows on a pristine lot, situated on a shady hill with a natural spring, and it is being nurtured by the people at M.S. Estate in Chikmagalur, Karnataka. The sweet natural water of the spring coupled with the jackfruit and citrus trees surrounding the lot add to the terroir and ultimately to the complex flavors of the bean. This coffee boasts bright, fruity, and floral notes that allure you to come back for more. 
   Origin  - M.S. Estate, Chikmagalur  
   Process  - Washed   
   Roast  - Medium

Name: Monsooned Malabar
Tasting_Notes: The flavors one might taste are reminiscent of cocoa and spices.
Desc:
Monsooned Malabar Arabica coffee offers a unique flavor profile due to the exposure of the beans to the monsoon rains and winds for a period of three to four months. The coffee acquired its name from what originally was a natural process happening on the Malabar Coast of south India. The flavors one might taste are reminiscent of cocoa and spices.   
   Origin  - Karnataka  
   Process  - Monsooned   
   Roast  - Light
